name: fig35_island_parameter_study
caption: (a) Bounded-minimiser and closed-form island locations agree to ~1e-8 (max difference in S_gen 1.1e-13). (b) Page time of the toy model against the entropy ratio r for several xi; xi (through kappa = mu xi) shifts it only slightly from the kappa -> 0 closed form 1 - (r/(1+r))^(3/2). (c) The normalised curve depends weakly on S0, so the shape is set by r and xi. All parameters are illustrative.
